meta.title: Local Jetpack Docs
meta.author: Jetpack
meta.description: Mount local Jetpack documentation into the pinned upstream DocsPress runtime.

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; $docs_root = realpath( '/wordpress/docspress-source-docs' ); $theme = wp_get_theme( 'docspress' ); $theme_root = get_theme_root( 'docspress' ) . '/docspress'; $importer = $theme_root . '/playground/import-local-docs.php'; $registry_file = $docs_root ? $docs_root . '/sidebars.json' : ''; if ( ! $docs_root || ! $theme->exists() || 'DocsPress' !== $theme->get( 'Name' ) || ! file_exists( $importer ) || ! is_file( $registry_file ) ) { wp_die( 'DocsPress local documentation importer or sidebar registry is unavailable.' ); } $registry = json_decode( (string) file_get_contents( $registry_file ), true ); if ( ! is_array( $registry ) || 1 !== (int) ( $registry['version'] ?? 0 ) || empty( $registry['default'] ) || empty( $registry['sidebars'] ) || ! is_array( $registry['sidebars'] ) ) { wp_die( 'DocsPress sidebar registry is invalid.' ); } $sidebar_entries = array(); $sidebar_ids = array(); $sidebar_roots = array(); $sidebar_order = 0; foreach ( $registry['sidebars'] as $sidebar_id => $configured_root ) { $sidebar_id = (string) $sidebar_id; $configured_root = trim( str_replace( '\\', '/', (string) $configured_root ) ); $sidebar_root = '.' === $configured_root ? '' : trim( $configured_root, '/' ); if ( ! preg_match( '/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$/', $sidebar_id ) || ( '' !== $sidebar_root && ! preg_match( '#^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*(?:/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)*$#', $sidebar_root ) ) || isset( $sidebar_roots[ $sidebar_root ] ) ) { wp_die( 'DocsPress sidebar registry contains an invalid or duplicate entry.' ); } $sidebar_entries[] = array( 'id' => $sidebar_id, 'root' => $sidebar_root, 'order' => $sidebar_order++ ); $sidebar_ids[ $sidebar_id ] = $sidebar_root; $sidebar_roots[ $sidebar_root ] = $sidebar_id; } $default_sidebar = (string) $registry['default']; if ( ! array_key_exists( $default_sidebar, $sidebar_ids ) || '' !== $sidebar_ids[ $default_sidebar ] ) { wp_die( 'The default DocsPress sidebar must exist at the documentation root.' ); } usort( $sidebar_entries, static function ( $left, $right ) { $depth = strlen( $right['root'] ) <=> strlen( $left['root'] ); return 0 !== $depth ? $depth : $left['order'] <=> $right['order']; } ); update_option( 'active_plugins', array_values( array_unique( array_merge( (array) get_option( 'active_plugins', array() ), array( 'docspress-blocks/docspress-blocks.php' ) ) ) ) ); update_option( 'template', 'docspress' ); update_option( 'stylesheet', 'docspress' ); require $importer; $seen_sidebar_roots = array(); foreach ( get_posts( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'posts_per_page' => -1, 'meta_key' => '_docspress_source_path' ) ) as $page ) { $source = (string) get_post_meta( $page->ID, '_docspress_source_path', true ); $relative = preg_replace( '#^docs/#', '', $source ); $filename = realpath( $docs_root . '/' . $relative ); if ( ! $filename || ! str_starts_with( $filename, trailingslashit( $docs_root ) ) || ! is_file( $filename ) ) { wp_die( 'An imported documentation source path is invalid.' ); } $markdown = file_get_contents( $filename ); if ( false === $markdown ) { wp_die( 'An imported documentation source could not be read.' ); } $route = trim( (string) preg_replace( '/\.(?:md|markdown)$/i', '', str_replace( '\\', '/', $relative ) ), '/' ); $segments = '' === $route ? array() : explode( '/', $route ); $last = strtolower( (string) end( $segments ) ); if ( in_array( $last, array( 'index', 'readme' ), true ) ) { array_pop( $segments ); } $route = implode( '/', $segments ); $sidebar = null; foreach ( $sidebar_entries as $candidate ) { if ( '' === $candidate['root'] || $route === $candidate['root'] || str_starts_with( $route, $candidate['root'] . '/' ) ) { $sidebar = $candidate; break; } } if ( ! $sidebar ) { wp_die( 'An imported documentation route has no sidebar assignment.' ); } $is_sidebar_root = $route === $sidebar['root']; update_post_meta( $page->ID, '_docspress_sidebar_id', $sidebar['id'] ); update_post_meta( $page->ID, '_docspress_sidebar_root', $is_sidebar_root ? 1 : 0 ); if ( $is_sidebar_root ) { $seen_sidebar_roots[ $sidebar['id'] ] = true; } $content = preg_replace( '/<!--\s*docspress:.*?\s*-->\s*/s', '', (string) get_post_field( 'post_content', $page->ID, 'raw' ), 1 ); $content = preg_replace( '/(<pre class=\\x22wp-block-code\\x22><code)\\s+class=\\x22language-[A-Za-z0-9_+.-]+\\x22>/', '$1>', $content ); $metadata = array( 'version' => 1, 'key' => trim( get_page_uri( $page ), '/' ), 'source' => $source, 'hash' => hash( 'sha256', $markdown ), 'sourceContentBase64' => base64_encode( $markdown ), 'sidebarId' => $sidebar['id'], 'sidebarRoot' => $is_sidebar_root ); wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $page->ID, 'post_content' => wp_slash( '<!-- docspress:' . wp_json_encode( $metadata ) . " -->\n" . $content ) ) ); } foreach ( $sidebar_entries as $sidebar ) { if ( ! isset( $seen_sidebar_roots[ $sidebar['id'] ] ) ) { wp_die( 'A configured DocsPress sidebar has no authored root Page.' ); } } require_once $theme_root . '/inc/llms.php'; docspress_flush_llms_rewrite_rules();
